entities.name: Ulf
entities.description: A Tolarian Academy student with little magic but a knack for research, who finds a lost book on Corondor and flees with it.

entities.name: Thranegeld
entities.description: A dwarven artificer and docent who sets Ulf to research Corondor and is found dead afterward.

entities.name: Silas Brotten
entities.description: An esteemed docent of Old Vodalian who is revealed as a Phyrexian agent, chases Ulf for the book and is killed by Jared.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A grizzled swordsman bearing the Mark of the Elder Druid, the prize the Phyrexians are seeking, who rescues Ulf and sends him to Corondor with the book.

entities.name: Sol'kanar
entities.description: A figure of myth, once a maro-sorcerer and forest guardian, cursed by Geyadrone Dihada to be the Demon King of Corondor.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A planeswalker who cursed Sol'kanar and who is said to be waiting for Jared.

entities.name: Dakkon
entities.description: A figure against whom Sol'kanar wielded the Blackblade.

entities.name: Carth the Lion
entities.description: The founder of House Carthalion, against whom Sol'kanar fought.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who sent Brotten to the academy.

entities.name: The archmage
entities.description: The head of the Lat-Nam academy, who in the final scene transforms into a gray-skinned, tentacled woman who is pleased by Jared's involvement.

entities.name: Viashino ally
entities.description: A viashino who bursts through a wall to save Ulf, holds back Brotten and is later found dead, called an old friend by Jared.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Sleeper agents who have infiltrated the academy and murder Ulf's roommates and others.

entities.name: House Carthalion
entities.description: The rightful ruling house of Corondor, founded by Carth the Lion.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The academy where Ulf studies and where the Phyrexians have infiltrated.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: A kingdom usurped by Sol'kanar, to which Jared sends the book.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A legendary sword wielded by Sol'kanar.

entities.name: Book on Sol'kanar
entities.description: A mildewed volume in Old Vodalian detailing Sol'kanar's curse and how to lift it.

entities.name: Sylex blast
entities.description: The ancient event Ulf is assigned to research for class.

events.summary: Docent Thranegeld tests Ulf, finds he is no Phyrexian, and sets him to research Corondor secretly.
After weeks of searching, Ulf finds a mildewed book about Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor, and Dihada's curse.
events.quote: Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor.

events.summary: Ulf shows the book to Silas Brotten, who wants him to leave it with him, but Ulf refuses.
events.quote: Ulf hesitated, then shook his head. "I don't think I can, sir."

events.summary: Thranegeld tells Ulf to hide the book and share it only when they know who their friends are.
events.quote: "When the time's ripe and when we're sure of who our friends are, we'll share it."

events.summary: Ulf hides the book in the stables and returns to find his three roommates murdered.
events.quote: He had been dismembered, the pieces of him piled in a careful stack near the wall.

events.summary: Ulf finds Thranegeld dead in his chambers.
events.quote: the dwarf tilted and slid from the chair and onto the floor.

events.summary: Brotten's face splits, revealing a Phyrexian, and he demands the book as Ulf flees.
events.quote: A Phyrexian , Ulf realized with horror.

events.summary: Brotten and an infected student chase Ulf through the academy, killing students, until Ulf is cornered at a dead end.
events.quote: He tried to turn back, but it was too late.

events.summary: A viashino bursts through the wall to save Ulf and holds Brotten back.
A grizzled swordsman beheads the infected student who finds Ulf hiding in the library, and removes a tracker from Ulf.
events.quote: Standing over the body of the student was a grizzled man.

events.summary: The man kills five Phyrexian sleeper agents waiting outside the library with flame.
events.quote: "Yes, let's," said a deep voice behind them.

events.summary: Jared finds the dead viashino who had saved Ulf and swears his sacrifice will not be in vain.
events.quote: "You fought honorably, old friend," he murmured

events.summary: Brotten confronts the pair in the vestibule, names Jared Carthalion, and says Jared was always the prize.
events.quote: You were always the prize, Carthalion.

events.summary: Jared kills Brotten, who says Dihada is waiting for him.
events.quote: "She's waiting for you, Jared. Return to her."

events.summary: Jared sends Ulf with the book to Corondor while he returns to the academy.
events.quote: "You will take the book to safety. Bring it to Corondor.

events.summary: The archmage reveals himself to be a gray-skinned tentacled woman, pleased that Jared found the book.
events.quote: "How lucky you found the book, Jared.

relations.note: Jared asks why Sheoldred sent Brotten.
relations.quote: "Why did Sheoldred send you here?" Jared said.
Jared drove his sword past the guard of the broken blade and into Brotten's chest.

relations.note: Bears the Carthalion name and descends from the rightful rulers of Corondor.
relations.quote: House Carthalion were the rightful rulers of Corondor

relations.note: Cursed him and made him her demonic servant.
relations.quote: until he was cursed by the Planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada.

relations.note: Docent who trusts Ulf with the research.
relations.quote: I'm beginning to think there's more to you than meets the eye.

relations.note: Rescues Ulf and sends him to Corondor.
Jared calls him an old friend.
relations.quote: "You fought honorably, old friend," he murmured
